title: SUNPEED 2026 Invincible Sport current ride and weight check
publisher: 速比特-泡澡犬 via Douyin public index
notes: Current exact-family public review compares an XL 2026 Invincible mechanical-shifting alloy-wheel bike and reports 8.6 kg with pedals. It describes a quick, direct initial response but also identifies wheel differences as a confounder, so the ride impression is not accepted as frame-stiffness evidence.
